audit.why: Karma is a squishy poke/shield enchanter with only one tether root (Focused Resolve, W, 12s cd) as hard CC; Rell is a hard-engage tank whose instant W dismount stun she cannot answer. Content layer already frames this correctly (Tricky/7-10 for Rell, meaning Rell is favored per this project's diffRating convention).

content.spikes already tracks the real pattern: level-2 W dismount kills her outright since she has no hard CC to answer it, and Karma gains no level-6 power spike (Mantra just re-empowers earlier spells), so Rell's lead only compounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..3].side read "Karma" in the full layer, but content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both independently agree Rell wins every single stage (winRate 55.99%, 3056 games, no defect flagged). phases[4..6].side are the unaudited "Skill" placeholder, also disagreeing with the already-correct win[] array.
audit.why: Content's early/mid text already explains why: "Karma has no hard CC to stop your level-2 W engage" and "she has nothing but the empowered RQ snare to peel you." This is grounded in the kit (Karma's only hard CC is the W tether, easily broken by range/LoS per its own flag description) and matches both independent data sources, so I moved side to Rell for all 7 rows and rewrote the 4 templated why strings (previously generic boilerplate shared word-for-word with galio/hwei/janna/lulu) to state the actual Karma-specific reason.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..6].side to "Rell"; rewrote phases[0..3].why to name Karma's lack of hard CC, matching the already-correct win[] array (no win[] edit needed).
